photos.name: blind-baked-shells
photos.summary: Six blind-baked tartlet shells on a sheet pan resting on the stovetop. Golden brown with egg wash sheen, scalloped edges from fluted tart pans. Slight variation in shell sizes visible.

photos.name: filled-with-lemon-cream
photos.summary: Six tartlets filled with lemon cream on a sheet pan on the counter. Pale yellow cream with smooth, level surfaces. Ready for chilling.

photos.name: plated-with-whipped-cream
photos.summary: Single finished tartlet on a decorative black-and-white patterned plate with a spoon. Topped with a generous dollop of whipped cream over pale lemon filling. Warm ambient lighting.
